method: v2.6: rank causes → choose capture → lock confirmed shape that captures the cause. Also: hardened Savant fetch w/ cache validation, directional wind, EB shrinkage, platoon-split shape, pitch-mix fit + TRAP flags. Weights P25/Shape40(11 air-pull/8 barrel/7 zone-dmg/6 matchup/3 quality/3 recent/2 due)/Env15/Lineup12/Src8. Statcast (Savant) shape layer active.
